Case Study: Implementing POS Systems for Elate CC Pvt Ltd

Table of Contents

  • Client Profile:
  • Challenge:
  • Solution:
  • Implementation Process:
  • Results
  • Revenue Growth:
  • Conclusion
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Client Profile:

Business Name: Elate CC Pvt Ltd
Business Type: Medical Equipment Manufacturer
Location: Karachi, Pakistan
Business Size: Large (12+ years in operation) 

Challenge:

Elate CC Pvt Ltd supplies hospitals and clinics with medical devices, surgical instruments, and hospital linens, a catalog that spans thousands of SKUs, many requiring batch and expiry tracking. Manual processes had scaled past their limit: 

  • Inventory across thousands of line items, including biotechnology equipment, was tracked with spreadsheets that couldn’t keep pace with batch numbers and expiry dates, a compliance risk in medical supply. 
  • Manual order tracking caused shipment delays to hospital and clinic customers who depend on predictable delivery windows. 
  • Tax filing complexity grew as regulatory requirements evolved, with no automated system translating sales data into FBR-ready reports. 
  • Post-sale support requests (replacement parts, warranty claims) had no integrated system, so response times lagged. 

Solution:

The Elate CC Pvt Ltd decided to modernize its operations with the FBR-integrated POS system, tailor-made from its diverse variety of high-quality service standards for the individual products catalog, with one of the most trusted providers of POS systems in Pakistan-Hulm POS Solutions.

Implementation Process:

Needs Assessment:

  • Catalogued SKU volume and batch/expiry tracking requirements across the full medical devices and linens range. 
  • Mapped the existing order-to-delivery workflow to find where delays originated. 
  • Reviewed current FBR filing cadence and pain points with the finance team. 

Customization:

  • Advanced inventory module with batch management and low-stock alerts tuned per product category (devices vs. consumables vs. linens). 
  • Order management workflow with status tracking visible to both sales and dispatch teams. 
  • Automated tax computation mapped to Elate CC’s specific product tax categories. 

Integration with FBR:

  • Secure API connection between Hulm POS and FBR’s reporting system. 
  • Real-time, per-transaction reporting replacing manual monthly compilation. 
  • A dedicated compliance testing phase given the scale and diversity of Elate CC’s catalog. 

Staff Training:

  • Role-based training: sales staff on transactions and order tracking; finance staff on tax reporting; support staff on using order history for faster post-sale response. 
  • Phased go-live with continued Hulm support through the transition period. 

Results

  • Faster order fulfillment through integrated tracking, improving delivery predictability for hospital and clinic customers. 
  • Reduced inventory discrepancies across a catalog of thousands of SKUs, with batch and expiry tracking now automated rather than manual. 
  • Eliminated manual tax-calculation errors and consistently on-time FBR filings. 
  • Faster post-sale response times as support staff gained direct access to order and product history. 

Revenue Growth:

“With thousands of items and batch numbers to track, spreadsheets were always one step behind. Hulm’s system finally caught up to how big we’d actually grown.” Operations Lead, Elate CC Pvt Ltd 

Conclusion

Elate CC’s 12-year reputation for reliable medical supply was increasingly at odds with manual back-office processes. The FBR-integrated Hulm POS system closed that gap giving the business batch-level inventory accuracy, dependable tax compliance, and faster customer response, without slowing down as the catalog kept growing.

More Case Studies

Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers to common questions about our services and support in our FAQ section.

Can a POS system handle batch and expiry tracking for medical supplies?

Yes. Hulm’s advanced inventory module supports batch numbers, expiry dates, and category-specific reorder alerts important for medical devices, surgical consumables, and pharmaceuticals.

Is Hulm POS suitable for B2B medical equipment distributors, not just retail shops?

Yes. Elate CC is a large-scale distributor selling to hospitals and clinics, not a walk-in retail counter. Hulm’s order management and inventory tools scale to that B2B, high-SKU-count environment.

How does FBR integration work for a large product catalog?
Every sale is reported to FBR automatically through a secure API connection at the point of transaction, regardless of catalog size, removing manual month-end compilation.

Case Study: Retail POS Systems for Real Tech System

From Local Roots to Global Trade and Modern POS Solutions

Table of Contents

  • Client Profile:
  • Challenge:
  • Solution:
  • Implementation Process:
  • Results
  • Conclusion
  • Frequently Asked Questions

Client Profile:

Business Name: Real Tech System
Business Type: Retail Shop
Location:
Karachi, Pakistan
Business Size:
Medium-sized

Challenge:

Muhammad Khurram’s store carries a wider spread of lower-ticket, high-volume accessory items alongside laptops, keyboards, mice, and headphones that turn over faster and generate more frequent warranty and exchange requests than big-ticket devices. That mix created a specific set of problems manual processes weren’t built for:

  • Warranty and exchange requests for accessories were logged in a paper register with no link back to the original sale, making disputed claims slow to resolve.
  • High-volume, low-value SKUs (cables, mice, headphones) were harder to keep accurately stocked than big-ticket laptops, since manual counts weren’t done as often for “small” items.
  • FBR tax filing was handled manually at month-end, a process Khurram described as the most stressful week of every month.

Solution:

Khurram chose Hulm POS Solutions for its combination of FBR integration and flexible inventory handling across both high-value and high-volume, low-value product lines.

Get Register Hulm POS Free Trail Account

Implementation Process:

Needs Assessment:

  • Reviewed the full product mix  laptops, keyboards, mice, headphones to right-size inventory alert thresholds per category rather than a single blanket rule. 
  • Mapped the existing warranty/exchange process to identify where the lack of sale-linked records slowed resolution. 

Customization:

  • Every sale automatically linked to a digital receipt record, so warranty and exchange requests can be verified in seconds instead of searched for in a paper log. 
  • Category-specific reorder thresholds tighter for high-turnover accessories, wider for higher-value laptops. 
  • Automatic FBR tax computation applied at checkout across all product categories. 

Integration with FBR:

  • API connection between Hulm POS and FBR for real-time, per-transaction reporting. 
  • Compliance testing run across sample transactions from each product category before go-live. 

Staff Training:

  • Training focused on the new digital receipt lookup process for warranty handling, alongside standard checkout and stock procedures. 
  • Ongoing Hulm support through the first weeks of live operation. 

Results

  • Warranty and exchange claims resolved in minutes instead of requiring a manual paper-log search. 
  • Fewer stock-outs on high-turnover accessories such as mice, keyboards, and headphones, once category-specific reorder alerts replaced manual counts. 
  • FBR tax filing shifted from a stressful month-end task to an ongoing, automated process with no manual compilation. 
  • Noticeably shorter checkout queues during high-footfall periods. 

Client Quote:

“Before, if someone came back with a broken mouse three weeks later, we had to dig through the register to prove they bought it here. Now it’s one search.” Muhammad Khurram, Owner, Real Tech System

Conclusion

Real Tech System’s challenge wasn’t just speed at the till it was managing a wide product mix, from big-ticket laptops to fast-moving accessories, without losing track of warranty history or falling behind on tax compliance. The Hulm POS rollout addressed both at once, giving Khurram a single system that scales across very different product categories. 

More Case Studies

Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers to common questions about our services and support in our FAQ section.

Can Hulm POS handle both high-value and high-volume, low-cost products in the same store?
Yes. Hulm supports category-specific inventory rules, so a store selling laptops alongside accessories like cables and headphones can set different reorder thresholds and tracking rules per category.
Does Hulm POS help with warranty or exchange claim handling?
Yes. Every sale is linked to a digital receipt record, so staff can verify a purchase and process a warranty or exchange claim without searching paper logs.
Is this the same system used by other Hulm retail clients?
Real Tech System uses the same FBR-integrated Hulm POS platform as other retail clients, configured specifically around its accessory-heavy product mix and warranty workflow — distinct from, for example, The Laptop Store’s single-category focus.

Can I use Hulm on my own hardware?

Privacy Policy

At Hulm Solutions, your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to protecting your personal and business information when you use our Point of Sale (POS) software and services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and billing details provided during account creation or support inquiries.
  • Business Information: Store details, tax registration, and transaction data required for POS operations.
  • Technical Data: IP address, device information, browser type, operating system, and usage logs to enhance system security and performance.
  • Payment Data: Processed securely via trusted third-party providers. We do not store your full payment card information.

How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

  • Deliver and improve our POS software and related services.
  • Process transactions and manage your subscriptions.
  • Provide customer support and respond to inquiries.
  • Communicate important updates, offers, and product information (with your consent).
  • Comply with legal, regulatory, and security obligations.

Data Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell your information to any third party. However, we may share it with:

  • Service Providers: For payment processing, cloud storage, analytics, or system maintenance.
  • Legal and Regulatory Authorities: If required to comply with applicable laws or legal processes.
  • Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or restructuring.

Data Retention

We retain your information only for as long as necessary to:

  • Provide our services.
  • Fulfill contractual obligations.
  • Meet legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Resolve disputes and enforce agreements.

Data Security

We employ strict security measures to protect your data, including:

  • SSL encryption for secure data transmission.
  • Regular system monitoring and security audits.
  • Restricted access to authorized personnel only.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access, update, or delete your personal information.
  • Opt out of marketing communications.
  • Request a copy of your stored data.
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

To exercise these rights, contact us at:
Email: info@hulmsolutions.com
Phone: +92 339 111 9259

Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Improve user experience.
  • Monitor website performance and analytics.
  • Provide tailored services and features.

You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings.

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or policies of third-party websites.

Children's Privacy

Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect or process information from children.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. All changes will be posted on this page with the updated Aug/2025

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us:

Hulm Solutions

What is Purchase Order Management?

Purchase order management is the process of creating, tracking, and approving purchase orders in a business.

  • It ensures suppliers deliver on time, reduces errors, and keeps budgets in check.
  • Without a system, manual paperwork causes delays and mistakes. A digital purchase order software makes the process faster and more reliable.

Key Features of HULM Purchase Order Software

Real-Time Tracking

Vendor Management

Maintain a centralized database of suppliers, pricing, and order history to simplify procurement and strengthen relationships.

Approval Workflows

Streamline your PO approval process with role-based permissions and automated notifications for faster decision-making.

Integration with Inventory Management

Link purchase orders directly to your inventory system to maintain optimal stock levels and avoid overstocking or shortages.

Detailed Reporting

Access insightful reports on purchase trends, supplier performance, and cost analysis to make informed decisions.

HULM Purchase Order Management Benefits

Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers to common questions about our services and support in our FAQ section.

Q1: What is purchase order software?
Answer: Purchase order software is a digital tool that helps businesses create, manage, track, and approve purchase orders. It streamlines procurement, reduces errors, and saves time compared to manual processes.
Q2: Who can use purchase order management software?
Answer: Any business that buys products or services can use it—retailers, manufacturers, pharmacies, restaurants, schools, salons, and more.
Q3: What is a purchase order?
Answer: A purchase order (PO) is a formal document a buyer sends to a supplier listing products, services, quantities, and prices.
Q4: What is a purchase order number?
Answer: A purchase order number is a unique ID assigned to each PO. It helps track and reference orders quickly.
Q5: How do purchase orders work?
Answer: Buyers create and send a PO → suppliers approve and deliver → the PO is matched with the invoice before payment.
Q6: What are purchase orders?
Answer: Purchase orders are official documents confirming an order between a buyer and supplier before delivery.
Q7: Is a purchase order a contract?

Answer: A PO is not a complete contract but becomes legally binding once the supplier accepts it, ensuring both sides agree on terms.

Q8: What is a blanket purchase order?
Answer: A blanket PO is a long-term agreement to buy goods or services repeatedly from one supplier under set conditions.
Q9: How to generate a purchase order?
Answer: You can create POs manually or use purchase order management software like HULM to generate, approve, and track them automatically.
Q10: What is a purchase order invoice?
Answer: A purchase order invoice is the supplier’s bill that references the PO, ensuring correct billing and payment.

Effortless Vendor Management with HULM ​

Supplier management is required for effective supply chain management. HULM Solutions’ Vendor Management System helps in simplifying supplier relationship management, communication, and effective procurement workflows. Our solution scales according to your precise business needs, be it an extended global network or just a few local vendors. Streamlining activities allows you to build stronger relationships, improve procurement efficiency, and enhance growth while cutting costs and reducing errors. This is exactly the way HULM’s Vendor Management System will grow with your company and align with the changing supply chain parameters.

Contact us

Function of Vendor Management

Centralized Vendor Database

Maintain detailed records of all suppliers, including contact information, product catalogs, pricing, and performance history, in one easy-to-access platform.

Performance Tracking

Evaluate vendor performance using data-driven metrics, such as delivery times, quality, and compliance with terms, to make informed decisions.

Automated Communication

Streamline communication with vendors through automated purchase order updates, reminders, and alerts for better collaboration.

Integration with Procurement and Inventory Systems

Seamlessly connect your vendor management system with procurement tools and inventory management to ensure a smooth supply chain process.

Customizable Approval Workflows

Set up role-based permissions and approval workflows for vendor selection, contracts, and purchase orders, ensuring compliance and accountability.

Real-Time Insights

Generate detailed reports on vendor performance, cost analysis, and procurement trends to optimize vendor relationships and reduce expenses.

Benefits of Using HULM Vendor Management

Develop supplier relationships through open communication and automate tasks such as onboarding and contract renewals. Track prices to save costs, ensure compliance, and mitigate risks. Our system is designed around your specific growing business to cater for efficient yet scalable vendor management.

Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers to common questions about our services and support in our FAQ section.

Q: Do I need any technical knowledge to set up my store?
Ans: None at all. The Website module is a one-tap activation inside your existing POS dashboard. No code, no configuration, and no design work required. Your products are pulled automatically and your store is live within 60 seconds.
Q: What happens when I add new products in my POS?
Ans: New products appear on your store automatically — usually within seconds. This also applies to price updates, stock level changes, product descriptions, and images. Everything flows in real time without any manual action from you.
Q: Can I use my own custom domain (like myshop.com)?
Ans: Yes. On the free Starter plan, you get a yourname.mywebsite.pk domain. On the Growth plan, you can connect any custom domain you own — for example, zafarsports.com. We handle all DNS and SSL configuration automatically.
Q: Where do online orders go? Does my team need a separate system?
Ans: No separate system. Every online order appears directly in your POS dashboard — the same place you manage in-store sales. Inventory is automatically deducted when an order is placed. Your team processes online orders exactly like in-store ones.
Q: What payment methods are available for my customers?
Ans: The Website module includes JazzCash, EasyPaisa, direct bank transfer, and cash on delivery — out of the box, with no additional setup. These are the payment methods Pakistani customers are most comfortable with.
